title: Source indices lie below their block base
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite type, let $m,w,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $F$ assign a list of Boolean values to each pair consisting of an element of $\kappa$ and a Boolean list, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. For every stage $i$ and every source $s$—an input position, a Boolean constant, or a pair giving an earlier block and bit position—the vertex index assigned to $s$ by the tabulation encoding is strictly less than the base vertex index for stage $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a bit source (input, constant, or block coordinate)
